description: The legacy row of ADDENDUM R2.1 (v0, 1-hour range, Grafana 13.2.4, medium profile at 15 s): bin/perf.mjs report --expect reproduces it within --tolerance (0.25 by default). Refresh 6.5-7.1 s and first load 7.8 s; 19 requests per refresh, 6 of them variable queries; 14.8 s of sequential PromQL, 4.6 G samples, 2,143 KB of interpolated PromQL.
